title: A separably representable counterexample to Naimark's problem in ZFC
summary: We construct in ZFC a unital, simple, infinite-dimensional $C^*$-algebra whose nonzero irreducible representations form a single unitary equivalence class, but which admits a faithful representation on a separable Hilbert space. The algebra contains a unital copy of the canonical anticommutation relation (CAR) algebra, and the normalized CAR trace has a unique extension among all states. This extension is tracial, and its GNS representation is separable and faithful, with weak closure the hyperfinite $\mathrm{II}_1$ factor.
